MUIT Lucknow and Noida Campus Admissions Online Form 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Maharishi University MUIT Lucknow and Noida Campus has invited online applications for the UG, PG and Diploma Courses Admissions 2026 on the official website of the MUIT recently. Online registration process for MUIT Admission 2025 has started from 15 March 2026. The last date to apply for the MUIT Admission 2025 is 15 July 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for MUIT Admission Online Form 2026 which has given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 15 March 2026
  • Last Date : 15 July 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 17 July 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card Available : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS Candidates : Rs. 500/-
  • SC, ST Candidates : Rs. 500/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
